title: Standing compositor followed by its explicit inverse is the identity
statement: With P,f,g,L and b as in [def-pur-standing-composition-inverse], let c:(gf)!L→f!g!L be the specified standing counit mate of [pur9-def-upper-shriek-composition]. Then c ≫ b = id_(gf)!L. No smoothness or absolute separatedness of the schemes is assumed.

source.place: The specified counit mate and its inverse-transpose argument in thm-pur-composition-coherence

proof.text: The inverse of the Hom equivalence E_K is exactly the displayed b formula, since inverse composition reverses the order: inverse f transpose, inverse g transpose, alpha inverse, then gf transpose. Naturality in K is obtained from full faithfulness on etale representatives, fixedCompactSupportComparisonIso naturality and both adjunction naturalities. Put R=(gf)!L and V=f!g!L. Then c=E_R(id) and b=E_V.symm(id). Naturality gives E_K(a)=a≫c; thus b≫c=id. Apply injectivity of E_R to c≫b and id; naturality and b≫c=id give c≫b=id. Both objects have the required plus etale-origin witnesses. Empty schemes, zero objects and the zero coefficient ring require no extra assumption.

proof_origin.place: The specified counit mate and its inverse-transpose argument in thm-pur-composition-coherence

theorem standingExceptionalComposition_inverse_hom (P : WeilConjectures.PurityFiniteSetting.{u})
    {X Y S : Scheme.{u}}
    [X.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))] [Y.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [S.Over (Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (X ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (X ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (Y ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (Y ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [LocallyOfFiniteType (S ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [QuasiCompact (S ↘ Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ S)
    [f.IsOver (Spec (.of P.field.k))] [g.IsOver (Spec (.of P.field.k))]
    [IsSeparated f] [LocallyOfFiniteType f] [QuasiCompact f]
    [IsSeparated g] [LocallyOfFiniteType g] [QuasiCompact g]
    (L : DerivedCategoryBoundedConstructible (ModuleCat.{u + 1} P.Coefficient) S) :
    standingExceptionalComposition P f g L ≫
      standingExceptionalCompositionInverse P f g L = 𝟙 _
